why_this_exists: Steps 45 and 293 tested pairs trading and both lost money at zero cost, worse than random pairs. The owner asked whether that was a shallow test. Four things were never tried: pairs restricted to an economically linked industry (the KO/PEP idea), the Avellaneda-Lee residual s-score, an adaptive hedge ratio, and daily bars. Step 293 itself declared that its weekly panel cannot see convergence trades that open and close inside a week. The daily panel exists on disk -- broad_full_history_price_vintages is the source the weekly panel is resampled from -- so the weekly-bar objection can be removed at no data cost.
the_order_of_work_is_fixed_by_CLAUDE_md_: Skill screen first: rank IC, top-minus-bottom decile spread and decile monotonicity. A book is built ONLY for a trial that passes every screen criterion. If neither trial passes, no book is built and the family closes.

data.prices: data/broad_full_history_price_vintages/20261010T135148Z-broad-full-history-v1 -- Yahoo daily adjusted closes, 2011-01-03 to 2026-10-09, 2,775 of 3,235 requested symbols
data.industry: as-filed SIC from SEC FSDS sub.txt, 2012Q1-2022Q4; for each decision the latest filing accepted BEFORE the decision is used, carried forward after 2022Q4. Firms with no FSDS filing before a decision are excluded at that decision.
data.not_used: the Tiingo delisted probe cache: it covers 273 names of only one sub-universe, and splicing a second provider into one leg of a residual regression is a source of artificial divergences

universe_rule_per_decision: cik has a positive close on the decision day, a complete 60-day return history ending on it, a close of at least $5 (penny-stock bid-ask bounce would dominate a 5-day reversal signal), and a known SIC2 group with at least 5 other eligible members that day.

T1_avellaneda_lee_s_score.source: Avellaneda and Lee (2010), 'Statistical arbitrage in the US equities market'. Recorded from general knowledge of the paper, not a read of the text this session.
T1_avellaneda_lee_s_score.factor: leave-self-out equal-weight mean daily return of the stock's SIC2 group. The paper used sector ETFs; no daily sector ETF history is on disk, and an in-universe industry mean is a closer industry hedge than an 11-sector ETF.
T1_avellaneda_lee_s_score.estimation: 60 trading days ending on the decision day. OLS of stock return on factor return with intercept; X = cumulative residual; AR(1) X[k+1] = a + b X[k] + e.
T1_avellaneda_lee_s_score.filters: 0 < b < exp(-1/30), i.e. mean-reversion speed kappa = -252 ln b above 252/30, as in the paper
T1_avellaneda_lee_s_score.score: s = (X_last - m_centered) / sigma_eq with m = a/(1-b), m_centered = m minus its cross-sectional mean, sigma_eq = sqrt(var(e)/(1-b^2)). The traded direction is -s: a stretched-high residual is expected to fall.

T2_same_industry_pairs.source: GGR minimum-distance selection restricted to an economic link -- the owner's KO/PEP idea.
T2_same_industry_pairs.selection: within each SIC4 code, each eligible stock is paired with the single other SIC4 member of minimum sum of squared deviations of price normalised to 1 at the start of the prior 252 trading days. Needs 252 days of history for both.
T2_same_industry_pairs.score: z = (normalised spread on decision day) / (formation std of the spread); score = -z
T2_same_industry_pairs.target_for_T2: the stock's forward return minus its partner's forward return over the same window

trials.nothing_will_be_swept: Window 60, kappa filter, $5 floor, 252-day formation and the 5-day horizon are fixed above. No variant is run if a trial fails.

measurement.decisions: every 5th trading day, first decision 2012-01-03 (2013 for T2's 252-day formation), so forward windows do not overlap
measurement.skip_one_day: signal computed at close t; the forward window runs close t+1 to close t+6. Step 250 found same-close short-term reversal is bid-ask bounce; this primary measurement excludes it. The no-skip version is reported as a diagnostic only.
measurement.primary_target_T1: industry-relative forward return: stock minus leave-self-out SIC2 mean over the same window
measurement.per_decision: Spearman rank IC; top-minus-bottom decile spread; monotonicity = Spearman of decile number against decile mean
measurement.significance: block bootstrap on the IC series, block 8 decisions, 4000 draws
measurement.cumulative_search_note: the bar covers the two trials here only. They sit on top of 314 steps and the project's earlier pairs, reversal and residual-reversal trials on the same names, so any pass is the survivor of a far larger search and must be described that way.
measurement.placebo: 200 within-decision shuffles of the score; the real mean IC must exceed the placebo 95th percentile
measurement.leave_one_out: mean IC recomputed excluding each SIC2 group in turn, and excluding the 10 names with the largest contribution to IC; minimum reported
measurement.regimes: 2012-2019, 2020, 2021-2022, 2023-2026 and full. 2008-2009 is NOT testable: the daily panel starts 2011.

screen_pass_requires_all: mean IC > 0 on the full window, bootstrap p < 0.025
mean monotonicity > 0.5 on the full window
mean IC > 0 AND monotonicity > 0 in BOTH halves, 2012-2018 and 2019-2026
real mean IC above the placebo 95th percentile

book_only_if_screen_passes.rule_T1: Avellaneda-Lee bands verbatim: open long at s < -1.25, open short at s > +1.25, close long at s > -0.50, close short at s < +0.75. Evaluated daily on signals from close t, executed at close t+1. Equal weight within each side, dollar neutral.
book_only_if_screen_passes.rule_T2: open at |z| > 2 (GGR), close at z crossing 0, pair held long/short equal dollars, re-paired every 252 days
book_only_if_screen_passes.costs: 0, 10, 50, 100 bps per side on traded notional, plus 100 bps annual borrow on the short side
book_only_if_screen_passes.metrics: CAGR, Sharpe, volatility, max drawdown, beta to the equal-weight universe, per regime
book_only_if_screen_passes.gates: the four Step 293 gates: orthogonality < 0.30 to the valuation and growth books, standalone Sharpe >= 1.0 at 50 bps, beats placebo, |beta| < 0.30

known_weaknesses_declared_up_front: Survivorship: 460 of 3,235 requested symbols returned nothing from Yahoo, overwhelmingly delisted issuers. This is the same limitation Step 293's weekly panel carried, since that panel is resampled from this source. A reversal signal is likely flattered by it: names that fell and kept falling to delisting are the ones missing.
Close-to-close only; no bid-ask, no opening auction. A 5-day reversal signal is exactly where spread costs dominate, which is why the book's cost ladder starts at 10 bps per side, not 0.
SIC carried forward after 2022Q4 and missing for firms that began filing after it.
No short-sale feasibility or name-specific borrow.
declared_sign: POSITIVE for -s and -z. A negative result is reported as a refutation, never inverted into a momentum strategy.
